messages:
Renee (sec-eng): Noticing intermittent mTLS failures after the RBAC change that removed kms:Decrypt from rotator-role in eu-central.
Marco (infra): Any log snippet?
Renee (sec-eng): Proxy log: ```
2026-03-23T02:02:11Z proxy-eu tls: unwrap failed: AccessDenied KMS key=alias/region-keystore principal=role/rotator-role
```
Ivy (sre): I saw a 30s error spike svc-auth -> svc-profile at 02:02. Looks canaryed to eu-central nodes.
AuditBot: ALERT KMS-DENY-1771: 10 KMS:Decrypt DENY events for arn:aws:iam::111111:role/rotator-role between 2026-03-23T02:01:58Z and 2026-03-23T02:02:30Z. Logs archived: /logs/sec/kms/2026-03-23/1771.json
Marco (infra): Quick mitigation: provision a timeboxed allow for `service-account/proxy-fanout` to kms:Decrypt on alias/region-keystore for 20m via infra pipeline; bump proxy cache TTL to 3m in canary. No console edits.
Ivy (sre): Running infra emergency job: `./infra/iam-hotfix --grant "proxy-fanout:kms:Decrypt:alias/region-keystore" --duration 20m --tag incident-mtls-eu-central`
DeployBot: Started job j-401 by Ivy (sre). Logs: /ci/jobs/j-401/logs
Ivy (sre): Patch applied to canary 1/4, cache TTL updated. Error rate dropped to baseline within ~40s.
Renee (sec-eng): Postmortem actions: add RBAC preflight to simulate KMS decrypt as rotator principal, increase default proxy cache TTL, implement rotator fallback to cached chain on decrypt failure, and retain KMS deny logs 90d.
Marco (infra): I'll open infra PR for the preflight check and add an observability gate: fail rollout if KMS Deny > 0 in canary window for 1m.
Ivy (sre): Linking incident ticket SEC-4800 once postmortem draft exists. Closing thread unless more alerts. :lock:
